name: L7
summary:
L7 is RobotEra’s full-size bipedal humanoid for dynamic movement and manipulation. In its CES 2026 manufacturer announcement, RobotEra specifies 171 cm height, 70 kg mass, 55 degrees of freedom and up to 20 kg carried with both arms.

The CES demonstration used full-body teleoperation. RobotEra offers full bipedal and upper-body configurations for different integration needs. Its stated applications combine physical handling with coordinated motion; demonstrations and manufacturer specifications do not establish autonomous performance in every deployment scenario.
